note: Sounds of a home for "Hear home". Public-domain recordings from Wikimedia Commons (SHA-1 checked against Commons when downloaded). They are not data and not the listener's home. No clip contains a person's voice: the NASA Space Apps terms bar recognizable voices of anyone under 18, need the consent of any adult who is featured, and require third-party material to be free of restrictions. Each excerpt starts where the household is busiest, because the app plays it from its start. Each was cut with ffmpeg, high-passed (mains hum removed), mixed to mono and encoded as 96 kbps MP3 so every browser, iPhone included, can play it. Where a recording was made very close to its source, short knocks are brought nearer to the rest (a test checks that none stands far over it).
